python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root = Path('/var/folders/3q/zc3tlwsj1p1_pskzk1j9r5100000gn/T/wb-evaluation-sft1jwcb/c8e7cd8d846e')
repo = root / 'repo'
contract = json.loads((root / 'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
started_clock = time.perf_counter()
commands = []

def run(command, cwd, env=None):
    clock = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    entry = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'elapsed_seconds': round(time.perf_counter() - clock, 6)}
    commands.append(entry)
    return entry

input_checks = []
for name, expected in contract['input_files_sha256'].items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    input_checks.append({'path': name, 'expected_sha256': expected, 'actual_sha256': actual, 'matches': expected == actual})
assert all(check['matches'] for check in input_checks)
head = run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], repo)
status_before = run(['git', 'status', '--short'], repo)
probe = '''import json
import sys
from service import renewal_action
results = []
for case, inputs, expected in [('TC-RETRY', {'refresh_pending': False, 'refresh_failed': True}, 'retry'), ('TC-PENDING', {'refresh_pending': True, 'refresh_failed': False}, 'wait')]:
    actual = renewal_action(**inputs)
    predicates = []
    for assertion, passes in [('required action', actual == expected), ('no logout', actual != 'logout')]:
        predicates.append({'assertion': assertion, 'passed': passes})
    results.append({'case': case, 'inputs': inputs, 'expected_action': expected, 'actual_action': actual, 'predicates': predicates})
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if all(predicate['passed'] for result in results for predicate in result['predicates']) else 1)
'''
revisions = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='tc-retry-review-', dir='/private/tmp') as temp_name:
    temp = Path(temp_name)
    for label, revision in [('baseline', contract['base_revision']), ('candidate', contract['candidate_revision'])]:
        snapshot = temp / label
        snapshot.mkdir()
        files = []
        for name in ['service.py', 'test_characterization.py']:
            result = run(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + name], repo)
            assert result['exit_code'] == 0
            content = result['stdout'].encode()
            (snapshot / name).write_bytes(content)
            files.append({'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), 'source': revision + ':' + name})
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
        env['PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX'] = str(temp / 'cache')
        suite = run([sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', '.', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], snapshot, env)
        observed = run([sys.executable, '-c', probe], snapshot, env)
        revisions.append({'label': label, 'revision': revision, 'files': files, 'supplied_suite': suite, 'behavior_probe': observed, 'observations': json.loads(observed['stdout'])})
    cache_outside_fixture = str(temp / 'cache')
status_after = run(['git', 'status', '--short'], repo)
output = {'started_at_utc': started, 'finished_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'elapsed_seconds': round(time.perf_counter() - started_clock, 6), 'python_executable': sys.executable, 'python_version': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(), 'head': head['stdout'].strip(), 'input_hash_checks': input_checks, 'revisions': revisions, 'commands': commands, 'repository_status_before': status_before, 'repository_status_after': status_after, 'cache_settings': {'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX': cache_outside_fixture, 'temporary_directory_removed': True}, 'timeout_seconds_per_command': 30}
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
